name: Miria
source:
Has a youthful face and large breasts, she is not part of any club.

She talks like a child and is very sweet.  She likes to play with grown men. Calls the main character “Baba”. 

[From [url=http://green.ribbon.to/~natsushi/sakuhin_musutomo.html]official site[/url]]
